method: Controlled: uniform PQ d=4 K=512 with per-expert calibration is the baseline; each arm changes ONE projection group to d=2 K=16 and holds the other at d=4. Same class, same calibration, same gate, so the difference is attributable to the projection.

ORGANS.byte_cost_note: 1408 = 2^7*11 pins its group at 128 and contributes 0.0417 b/w of irreducible scale overhead in the 1-bit grammar
ORGANS.execution_frequency: every routed token, top-6 of 64 experts
ORGANS.allocation_reading: MOST likelihood-sensitive per weight. Coarsening it costs 0.947 ppl from a third of the weights. Spend bits here for likelihood.

ORGANS.execution_frequency: every routed token, top-6 of 64 experts
ORGANS.allocation_reading: Half the likelihood sensitivity per weight, and coarsening it moves diversity the OTHER way (+0.075 vs -0.108). Two thirds of the bytes sit here.
ALREADY bf16 and never quantized by the evaluator -- verified by inspection, which refuted the router-corruption hypothesis in seconds. 0.0025 EBPW to keep exact. An exact island by default.

DEMOTIONS_ENFORCED.reconstruction_error: cheap filter and local diagnostic ONLY; may not rank final candidates. PQ had 45% lower error than affine at fewer bits and worse capability.
DEMOTIONS_ENFORCED.distinct_ratio: diagnostic phenotype explaining WHY a candidate fails; may not replace the conjunction gate.

ALLOCATION_RULE_DERIVED: Spend bits on down_proj for likelihood and on geometry (finer cells) for diversity, and note they conflict: no single geometry on down_proj satisfies both, which is what the PQ Scar records.
